prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with back strain after a hit while turning left. The patient had 9 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1450; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which the patient's vehicle was struck while the patient was turning left. The patient reported low back pain and stiffness beginning shortly after the impact. The mechanism of injury described is consistent with the lumbar strain diagnosed. Over the course of nine visits, care consisted of manual therapy, supervised therapeutic exercise, and home exercise instruction. Treatment continued somewhat longer than is typical for a strain of this type, reflecting a slower-than-expected recovery of range of motion. Examination documented paraspinal muscle tenderness and reduced lumbar flexion, findings that support the reported injury. Other testing, including neurological screening and straight leg raise, was within normal limits. The patient reports no prior injury to the lower back. Billing records reflect single charges for each service rendered, with no repeated or duplicate entries. Current assessment is lumbar strain, improving, with an anticipated return to baseline function and discharge from active care once strength and mobility goals are met.
